prompts: cidr_contains(cidr, ip) in netblock.py (already correct - do not modify it) returns True iff the IPv4 address `ip` falls within the CIDR block `cidr` (e.g. '10.0.0.0/8'). Write pytest tests at exactly test_netblock.py (functions named test_*, plain asserts, exact boolean values) with at least 4 test functions covering: an address inside a /24 and one just outside it, the prefix-length boundary (an address that shares the first /8 but not the /16, tested against both), a /32 matching ONLY its exact address (and rejecting a neighbour), and a /0 matching everything (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0 contains any address). import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path("netblock.py")
TEST = "test_netblock.py"
MUTANTS = [
    # mask off-by-one: shifts by (31 - prefix), widening every block
    ["    mask = (0xFFFFFFFF << (32 - prefix)) & 0xFFFFFFFF if prefix else 0",
     "    mask = (0xFFFFFFFF << (31 - prefix)) & 0xFFFFFFFF if prefix else 0"],
    # /0 degenerates to matching nothing instead of everything
    ["    mask = (0xFFFFFFFF << (32 - prefix)) & 0xFFFFFFFF if prefix else 0",
     "    mask = (0xFFFFFFFF << (32 - prefix)) & 0xFFFFFFFF if prefix else 0xFFFFFFFF"],
    # comparison flipped to != so membership is inverted
    ["    return (ip_to_int(ip) & mask) == (ip_to_int(network) & mask)",
     "    return (ip_to_int(ip) & mask) != (ip_to_int(network) & mask)"],
]


def run_tests():
    for p in Path(".").rglob("__pycache__"):
        shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "pytest", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-q", TEST]
    ).returncode


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified (anchor not found once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests do not verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)")

reference_solution.test_netblock.py:
from netblock import cidr_contains


def test_inside_and_outside_a_24():
    assert cidr_contains("192.168.1.0/24", "192.168.1.55") is True
    assert cidr_contains("192.168.1.0/24", "192.168.2.1") is False


def test_prefix_length_matters():
    # shares the first /8 but not the /16
    assert cidr_contains("10.0.0.0/8", "10.99.99.99") is True
    assert cidr_contains("10.1.0.0/16", "10.99.99.99") is False


def test_slash_32_is_exact():
    assert cidr_contains("10.0.0.5/32", "10.0.0.5") is True
    assert cidr_contains("10.0.0.5/32", "10.0.0.6") is False


def test_slash_0_matches_everything():
    assert cidr_contains("0.0.0.0/0", "8.8.8.8") is True
    assert cidr_contains("0.0.0.0/0", "255.255.255.255") is True
